Kamyanka-Buzka New Jewish Cemetery on Shashkevycha Street

Jewish Cemetery · L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. In 2014, Meylakh Sheykhet — the same named heritage advocate documented at Zhydachiv elsewhere in this collection — initiated a court case that revealed the location of this cemetery, based on documents not otherwise available to the public; the ESJF could find no other evidence of its existence, and it does not appear on any old maps. This is the newer of Kamyanka-Buzka's Jewish cemeteries, serving the same community whose own Hasidic dynasty was founded here in 1837, documented at the town's Old cemetery elsewhere in this collection.
